description.short: Chart sample sales or an attached CSV/Excel table where supported.
description.full:
Turn fictional 2025 sales or an explicitly attached CSV/Excel table into charts in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Ask about built-in revenue, profit, orders or units, compare regions and products, follow monthly trends, filter results, and drill into the synthetic sales data.

Where file delivery is supported, attach one UTF-8 CSV or .xlsx file of at most 1,000,000 bytes, 2,000 rows and 30 columns. Discover its columns, compare sums or averages, count records, and chart trends. Excel reads only the first worksheet; formulas, macros and legacy .xls are not supported. Direct Teams file APIs support personal chats; other hosts must supply a supported download link. No delegated Graph access is added.

Simple charts use native Adaptive Cards where supported; other visualizations use images. File charts use follow-up questions rather than sales-specific drill buttons. Client capabilities and tenant policies determine attachment and rendering availability.

The built-in database is synthetic. Uploaded data is not automatically synthetic. This sample does not connect to your organization's databases or search documents, and it is not intended for financial decisions. Verify results before use.
